title: Create Footer Component with Company Branding
description: Implement a clean, responsive footer component with company logo and essential navigation links using shadcn/ui components
details: Create components/layout/Footer.tsx as a server component. Include company logo/branding, essential navigation links (About, Privacy, Terms, Contact), and social media icons. Use Tailwind CSS for responsive design with proper spacing and typography. Implement dark mode support using CSS variables. Structure the footer with a centered layout on desktop and stacked layout on mobile. Use semantic HTML elements like <footer> and proper link accessibility.
test_strategy: Create unit tests to verify footer renders correctly with all links and logo. Test responsive behavior across different screen sizes. Verify dark/light theme compatibility and accessibility with screen readers.

title: Create Theme Toggle Client Component
description: Implement a client-side theme toggle component that integrates with next-themes for dark/light mode switching
details: Create components/ThemeToggle.tsx as a client component using 'use client' directive. Integrate with next-themes provider to handle theme switching. Use lucide-react icons (Sun/Moon) and shadcn/ui Button component. Implement smooth transitions and proper ARIA labels for accessibility. Handle theme persistence and system preference detection. Include loading state to prevent hydration mismatches.
test_strategy: Test theme switching functionality, verify persistence across page reloads, test system preference detection, and ensure proper accessibility attributes are present.

title: Implement Extended Navbar with Authentication Awareness
description: Create a comprehensive navigation bar that adapts based on user authentication status with responsive mobile menu
details: Create components/layout/Navbar.tsx as a server component that receives user session data as props. Implement desktop navigation using shadcn/ui NavigationMenu with links to key sections. For authenticated users, display Avatar with DropdownMenu containing Dashboard, Settings, and Logout options. For guests, show Sign In/Sign Up buttons. Include search icon and theme toggle integration. Implement mobile-responsive hamburger menu using shadcn/ui Sheet component. Use proper semantic HTML and ARIA attributes for accessibility.
test_strategy: Test conditional rendering based on authentication status, verify mobile menu functionality, test keyboard navigation and screen reader compatibility, and validate responsive behavior across devices.

title: Integrate Components into Root Layout with Theme Provider
description: Update the root layout to include the new Navbar and Footer components with proper theme provider setup
details: Modify app/layout.tsx to import and render the new Navbar and Footer components. Set up next-themes ThemeProvider to wrap the application for theme switching functionality. Fetch user session data server-side using better-auth and pass it as props to the Navbar component. Ensure proper component hierarchy with theme provider at the top level. Configure theme provider with attribute='class' for Tailwind CSS integration and defaultTheme='system' for system preference detection.
test_strategy: Verify components render correctly across all pages, test theme provider functionality, validate session data is properly passed to Navbar, and ensure no hydration errors occur during SSR.
